content.short: Butter Network enables an omnichain hub for secure, fast cross-chain transactions with low fees.
content.description: Butter Network is an omnichain interoperability hub, founded in 2021, that enables seamless cross-chain transactions. By integrating Zero-Knowledge (ZK) technology, it strengthens security and scalability for developers and users interacting with multiple blockchains. The platform supports fast swaps with low gas fees, delivering a smooth DApp experience and dependable data availability across networks. This approach helps developers build cross-chain applications with confidence, enabling secure, scalable interactions across ecosystems.
